title: Where does rain come from?
examples: How does water get up into the sky?
What happens when the rain falls back down?

explain.say: Look up at the sky. You can see clouds floating there.

draw.text: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets.

explain.say: Now look. This is the water cycle in 3D. Can you see the Sun and the evaporation? Tap any part to hear about it.
Tiny water droplets in a cloud bump into each other. They join and get bigger.

draw.text: Droplets join to form bigger clouds.

explain.say: When the drops get too heavy, they fall from the cloud.
The water falls as rain. Rain fills rivers and lakes. We get drinking water from them.

draw.text: Rain falls from the sky to Earth.

explain.say: Rain flows into rivers and the sea. Then the Sun warms the water, and it goes up again.
A puddle dries up when the Sun heats it. The water goes up as a gas you cannot see.

draw.text: Sun heats puddles, water goes up.

faq.a: No, clouds can also make snow or hail. They are just carrying water in different forms.
asks: Can clouds make other things besides rain?
What else can come out of a cloud?

faq.q: Why is the water invisible when it goes up?
faq.a: When water warms up, some of it turns into a gas called water vapour. You cannot see this gas.
asks: Why does the water disappear into the sky?

faq.q: Does the rain always fall straight down?
faq.a: Sometimes the wind blows the rain sideways. It can also drizzle gently for a long time.

faq.q: How long does this water cycle take?
faq.a: The water cycle never stops. It happens all the time, every day, all over the world.
asks: Is the water cycle fast or slow?
Does the water cycle ever end?

faq.q: What is the difference between rain and mist?
faq.a: Rain falls from clouds in drops. Mist is just very small water droplets floating near the ground.
asks: What is the difference between fog and rain?

facts: Water evaporates from rivers and oceans.
Clouds form when water vapour cools and turns back into liquid.
Precipitation is the water falling back to Earth.
The water cycle keeps Earth's water fresh.

quiz.say: The Sun warms water, and it rises as a gas. What is this called?
quiz.show: ☀️ 💧 Water goes up as a gas
quiz.why: Evaporation is when water turns into a gas and rises.

quiz.say: Water vapour rises and cools high in the sky. What does it make?
quiz.why: Cool water vapour turns into tiny droplets. They make clouds.

wrong.2: Rainbows come from sunlight shining through raindrops.

quiz.say: The drops in a cloud get too heavy. What happens next?
quiz.why: Heavy drops fall from the cloud as rain.

wrong.0: Heavy drops sink, so they cannot float higher.
wrong.1: Heavy drops keep moving, and they fall down.
